log_pipe_02_mid.evidence: v1.5 recovered pipe pattern formula; wave shading uses original normal texture with approximate lighting
log_pipe_02_mid.fluidStatus: Source item colors; inset liquid with subtle continuous radius waves, a planar moving front with a filled white-to-blue cap gradient, whole-route thinning to disappearance and interrupted recovery; soft two-color gas turbulence. Screenshot-guided 2D reconstructions sharing the existing liquid interior map. Full game shader, gas mesh and SceneColor refraction are not reproduced.

transportTiming.interpretation: One cell per transport round, continuously interpolated; demonstration fill/drain scheduling is project-defined

coordinates.headPosition: cells from route entry; controller snapshot.end includes route origin

usage.load: 图集 pages.file 相对本 JSON。静态只加载 group=static。传送带和标记继续使用 clips；流体改用 fluidPlayback 的长空间场和共享 Shader。
usage.placement: 每格源画布为 128×128，中心锚点。rect 是图集中裁剪后的矩形，spriteSourceSize 是其在原画布的位置；按 sourceSize 与 trim 恢复，禁止把窄帧拉伸到整格。规范流向上→下，左右弯分别从上进入、向左/右离开，随入流方向旋转。
usage.head: 水头使用连续全局坐标 H，段坐标为 i+along；同一条白色渐变在相邻格自然相差 0.5 秒。平直切面、向后 1.2 格白色渐变与软气体前缘在共享 Shader 中裁切，不读取旧的 head 帧。
usage.body: 水体和气体分别使用一张连续 128 格的烘焙场。水体 RG 保存左右边缘位移，BA 保存来源法线；在两个速度下连续采样并插值，整条路线共享全局坐标。没有新增逐帧贴图，也不在每格重置相位。气体原有雾纹与粗细波不变。
usage.drain: 整路线共用连续 thickness，2 秒从 1 到 0，直接收缩内液体轮廓；中途来水从当前值回升，不产生新水头。thickness=0 隐藏整条流体 Mesh。
usage.conveyor: 箭头与亮带为独立的相位序列。按每段的参数，arrowPhase=fract(i+origin-time*arrowSpeed)，highlightPhase=fract((i+origin-time*flowSpeed+timeOffset)*flowSpace)。各自 round(phase*phaseSamples)%phaseSamples；先 base，再 highlight，再 arrow。无需强求共同时间周期。
usage.marks: 移动双 V 保留源相位：q=(i+origin)*(2*waterDirection-1)-flowOffset，phase=fract((q+flowSpeed*waterTime)*flowDensity)。ENDFIELD 文字不进入相位动画帧，由路线层在不少于 3 格的连续直段上整枚放置已有 static logo core/glow；不得跨弯或显示残片。
usage.endpoints: 每条连续管线只在入口、出口各放一次 connector/whitening；内部格接缝不放。pipeShapes 包含支架装配信息，左右弯都有支架。
usage.colors: 流体改用中性空间场，运行时按 fluidProfiles 的 body/skin/skin2/splash 设置多色参数；勿给管壁、支架、标记染色。
usage.performance: 静态、标记和传送带仍为合批 Sprite；流体为每条路线一个共享 Mesh，预烘焙昂贵的多层雾噪声，运行时仅采样、连续粗细/前缘裁切和颜色合成。不能每格创建独立 Shader。
usage.example: index.html 顶部切换实时绘制与烘焙播放；?renderer=baked 直达烘焙，附加 &animate=1 播放。Tab 共用画布并保留选项和进度，旧 baked.html 自动跳转。烘焙使用 baked-flow.js，JSON 内含一致的参考 Shader；直接打开烘焙不加载 dynamic.js 或原独立动态贴图。
usage.tintableConveyor: 独立染色：按 tintableConveyor 依次画中性带面、边缘柔光、边缘实线、光斑、箭头。RGB 为亮度，A 为透明度；Sprite.tint 设为目标颜色。动画仅以 tintFrames 替代 frames，phaseSamples、索引顺序和所有时间/相位公式保持不变。
usage.pipeMask: static/pipe.{straight|left|right}.body-mask：管身投影内部 A=255，外部 A=0，按 Nearest 采样；不包含支架/接头，也不扣除其遮挡位置。不能用 shell Alpha 替代。
usage.background: 全部烘焙素材与背景独立，不含草地。先绘制实际背景与流体，再按 sceneTransmission 合成管道透色与反射；不要将 preview/ 草地或示例画布截图作为管道贴图。

approximations: 替代 v1 两格/一秒的复合帧重复。气体空间场为 128 格、约 248.47 秒平移周期，不是数学上的无限不重复；不同路线可额外设置整体相位。
离线噪声三个沿路频率取 211/128、429/128、847/128 以闭合长图边界；与绘制参考频率相近，约 32 个沿路采样/格，双线性重建。
流体不再是纯 AnimatedSprite：需要一个共享采样/裁切 Shader。原静态、传送带和标记图集接口保持不变。
水体内缩、两组弱粗细波、连续排空与平直白色水头保留绘制版公式；场景折射和游戏状态机仍是二维近似。

fluidPlayback.geometryFormat: per vertex: position float32x2, uv float32x2, start float32, shape float32; quad indices
fluidPlayback.mapping: Nearest texel center: R=wrapped cylindrical across; G/B=unsigned16 along; A=coverage. Raw channels, no color conversion or premultiplication.

waveRadius.waterFormula: .88+.06*(selected RG channel of the advected water field*2-1); independent left/right boundary, then multiply thickness

fluidPlayback.batch: One shared mesh per continuous route below middle supports/shell/marks, above back supports. One shader/material for all cells; update time/thickness/bounds once per route.
fluidPlayback.colors: Runtime body/skin/skin2/splash from fluidProfiles; field textures are neutral data, not pre-tinted RGBA frames.

surfaceUniforms.uWater: pages["water-field"]: raw RGBA field sampler, bilinear, no premultiply or color conversion
surfaceUniforms.uMapSize: pages["fluid-data"].width / 8; physical texels per shape, 128 or 64. Required to avoid interpolating the encoded cylindrical U seam.

waterSurfaceField.encoding: Raw RGBA, no premultiply/color conversion. RG=left/right displacement; BA=source normal XY.
waterSurfaceField.playback: Two bilinear samples at globalS-time*.8 and globalS-time*.7, mixed .75/.25. Never reset globalS per cell.
waterSurfaceField.source: T_pipe_water_normal_3; calibrated source-normal and multi-frequency displacement bake
waterSurfaceField.colors: No fluid color in field; body, skin, skin2 and splash remain independently tintable.

left.blend: normal source-over; RGB=brightness*tintRGB; A=textureAlpha*layerOpacity; premultiply once
left.frameSelection: Use the original clip phase formula and phaseSamples; select tintFrames[index] instead of frames[index].
left.placement: Same cell, pivot, rotation and trim as the colored resource. Replace base/static with these layers; do not stack both.

straight.blend: normal source-over; RGB=brightness*tintRGB; A=textureAlpha*layerOpacity; premultiply once
straight.frameSelection: Use the original clip phase formula and phaseSamples; select tintFrames[index] instead of frames[index].
straight.placement: Same cell, pivot, rotation and trim as the colored resource. Replace base/static with these layers; do not stack both.

right.blend: normal source-over; RGB=brightness*tintRGB; A=textureAlpha*layerOpacity; premultiply once
right.frameSelection: Use the original clip phase formula and phaseSamples; select tintFrames[index] instead of frames[index].
right.placement: Same cell, pivot, rotation and trim as the colored resource. Replace base/static with these layers; do not stack both.

opticalCalibration.environmentEvidence: Latitude illumination fitted on two empty-pipe strips, checked on two held-out strips; an estimated environment, not the recovered runtime reflection probe.

pipeSurfaceMaterial.reconstruction: Original single-surface mesh, normals, material slots and environment BRDF. Preferred composition: linear SceneColor * source GlassColor + baked environment reflection. Reflection environment estimated from reference; runtime probe and ECS GlassColor overrides are unavailable. Legacy RGBA shell is an approximation only. Serialized RefractRatio=1 and UseCustomRefractTex=0 imply no normal-dependent offset for this view.

sceneTransmission.encoding: optical-reflection RGB = linear reflected radiance * reflectionEncodingScale; A = geometric coverage. No color conversion. Premultiply once when compositing the optical map; unpremultiply before decoding its radiance.
sceneTransmission.fallback: shell/body/wall/reflection are legacy source-over approximations; do not stack them on the scene-transmission pass.

backgroundIndependence.previewOnly: The standalone example may contain preview/ grass; material archives do not.

textureProfile.colorFilter: formal Q85 WebP at selected size
